hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -q 'features/engine.py'; then echo '⚠️  ENGINE EDIT — run parity check: sha256sum features/engine.py hf-space/features/engine.py'; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_BASH_COMMAND" | grep -qiE '\.(fit|train|predict)\(' 2>/dev/null; then if ! echo "$CLAUDE_BASH_COMMAND" | grep -qE '(import|version|compile|--help)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: No ML training on VM (1 vCPU / 969MB RAM). Use HF Spaces or Colab.' >&2; exit 1; fi; fi; exit 0
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -q 'features/engine.py'; then echo '⚠️  ENGINE WRITE — sync to ALL 6 HF Spaces required! Run: /spaces-health then deploy.'; fi

FP="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$FP" in /home/termius/mon-ipad/*) REPO=/home/termius/mon-ipad ;; /home/termius/nomos-dashboard/*) REPO=/home/termius/nomos-dashboard ;; /home/termius/nomos-nba-agent/*) REPO=/home/termius/nomos-nba-agent ;; /home/termius/nomos-political-alpha/*) REPO=/home/termius/nomos-political-alpha ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "$REPO" && git add -A -- "$FP" >/dev/null 2>&1 && git -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -m "wip: auto-checkpoint $(basename $FP)" --quiet >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

if [ "$CLAUDE_STOP_REASON" = 'rate_limit' ] || [ "$CLAUDE_STOP_REASON" = 'billing_error' ]; then source /home/termius/mon-ipad/.env.local 2>/dev/null && NOMOS_TOKEN="$NOMOS42_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN" && ADMIN_ID=6582544948 && curl -s "https://api.telegram.org/bot${NOMOS_TOKEN}/sendMessage" -d "chat_id=${ADMIN_ID}&text=⚠️ Claude Code stopped: ${CLAUDE_STOP_REASON}" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0
